The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (2.00%) for
the intermeeting period.

(The following is an unofficial English translation of the Monetary Policy
Committee statement.)

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (2.00%) for the
intermeeting period.

Domestic economic activity has continued on a recovering
trend thanks to the progress of global economic situation.

Exports
and consumption have continued to improve.

There still, however,
remains uncertainty as to the economic growth path.

Consumer price inflation has accelerated somewhat, but seems
likely to remain generally stable.

The upward trend of real estate
prices has slowed.

Financial market price variables such as exchange rates and
stock prices have shown generally stable movements but their
volatility heightened somewhat at one stage under the influence of
international financial market unrest.

The mortgage lending has grown
on a similar scale to last month.

Looking ahead, the Committee will maintain the accommodative
policy stance for the time being with an emphasis on sustaining the
recovery of business activity.
